items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: I used to play over there too, but I didn't play with him.

ctx.x: At foot. You talk, you talk to any musician, anybody who used to listen to Professor, at the Caledonia, that's where he used to play. Because I used to play over there too, but I didn't play with him. They had two bands over there. He would hit, take his foot and hit up against his piano, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom. Now people used to like that. That's not music. But I mean, as long as the people liked it, I'm for him.
Well he had a certain amount of popularity in the late forties, didn't he?
